The package installs standard components: an icon, license, man page, and shell completion file—all from trusted, version-controlled sources.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, network exfiltration, or unauthorized downloads. No `curl`, `wget`, `eval`, `base64`, or `exec` calls are present. The build and package functions operate only on verified, local source files. The donation link in the description is informational and does not imply malicious behavior.
</details>
